docs.description: The open calendar panel of Date Picker — month header with prev/next, weekday row and a 6×7 grid of Day Cells. 3 variants: inline (true, false) × type (single, double) — double shows two months side by side for range selection; inline embeds the calendar in the page instead of floating it. month is a text prop. role=dialog when floating, role=grid inside; arrow keys move by day, Page Up/Down by month, Enter selects, Esc closes. Pairs with DatePicker, the field that opens it.

rules.reason: The calendar a DatePicker opens, or the page holds inline: a month's header with the previous and next months, its weekdays, and a grid of Date Picker Day Cells, one date chosen (owner decisions 2026-09-24: single dates; the week starts on the locale's first day). Bespoke on both platforms, a grid the arrow keys move the focus in, drawn with the shared layer helpers; its dates from the platform's own calendar, not a picker library, which draws its own days.
A floating calendar has an edge, shadow and corners, a surface of its own; one in the page has none, as its description says ("inline embeds the calendar in the page instead of floating it").
A double calendar lays its two months side by side, a single one stacks its parts.
